request.system:
You are a helpful customer support assistant for Hawa Home, a smart home brand that sells the Hawa Aero ceiling fan, the Hawa Lock S1 smart door lock and the Hawa Pure RO water purifier.

Answer the customer's question. You can use the tools to control their devices.

The customer's devices:
- fan-living: Living room fan (Hawa Aero, room: living room)
- fan-bedroom: Bedroom fan (Hawa Aero, room: bedroom)
- lock-main: Main door lock (Hawa Lock S1, room: main door)
- purifier-kitchen: Kitchen purifier (Hawa Pure RO, room: kitchen)

Some manual sections that may help:
[lock/batteries#low-battery-warning] Batteries: Low Battery Warning
The Lock S1 runs on 8 x AA alkaline batteries (1.5 V). Typical battery life is about 10 months
with 10 unlocks a day. Do not use rechargeable 1.2 V batteries; the lock will show low battery
too early.
- At 20% battery: the lock beeps 3 times after every unlock and the keypad shows a red battery
  icon. The app sends a "Low battery" notification.
- At 10% battery: the lock still works for about 50 more unlocks. Replace batteries now.
- At 5% battery: fingerprint and app unlock are disabled to save power; only PIN, card and
  mechanical key work.
Replace all 8 batteries at the same time. Your users and settings are not lost when you
change batteries.

[lock/batteries#emergency-power] Batteries: Emergency Power
If the batteries are completely dead and you are locked out, connect a power bank with a USB-C
cable to the emergency USB-C port at the bottom of the outer panel. The lock wakes up in about
10 seconds and you can unlock it with your own fingerprint or PIN. After entering, replace the
batteries immediately. You can also use the mechanical backup key behind the logo cover.

[lock/users#fingerprint-enrolment] Users: Fingerprint Enrolment
The first fingerprint you add becomes the Admin fingerprint. Only an admin can add or delete
other users.
Using the app: open Hawa Home > Lock S1 > Users > Add user > Fingerprint, then place the same
finger on the sensor 6 times, lifting it between each touch, until the app shows "Enrolled".
Using the keypad: press * then #, enter the admin PIN, press 1 (Add user) then 1 (Fingerprint),
and place the finger 6 times. The lock gives 2 short beeps when enrolment is successful.
Tips: enrol at least 2 fingers per person, keep fingers dry and clean, and enrol children's
fingers again every 6 months because fingerprints change as they grow.

[lock/security#auto-lock-and-wrong-attempts] Security: Auto-lock and Wrong Attempts
Auto-lock is on by default and locks the door 10 seconds after it closes. You can change the
delay between 5 and 60 seconds in the app (Lock S1 > Settings > Auto-lock).
After 5 wrong fingerprint, PIN or card attempts in a row, the keypad is frozen for 3 minutes
and the lock sounds an alarm. The app also sends a security alert to the admin. Use a
"scramble PIN" (extra random digits before or after your real PIN, up to 16 digits total)
to hide your PIN from people watching.
For your safety, Hawa support and the Hawa assistant never help anyone bypass, force open or
unlock a lock without the owner's own fingerprint, PIN, card, app or key.

messages.content: My door lock beeps 3 times after every unlock. Why?

Based on the Hawa Lock S1 manual, 3 beeps after every unlock (along with a red battery icon on the keypad and a "Low battery" app notification) indicates that your lock's battery level has dropped to **20%**. 

Here are a few quick tips regarding your batteries:
* The Lock S1 runs on **8 x AA alkaline batteries (1.5 V)**. 
* Please do not use rechargeable 1.2 V batteries, as they will trigger low-battery warnings too early.
* When replacing them, **replace all 8 batteries at the same time**. Your users and settings will not be lost when you change them.
Which batteries should I buy for it?

tools.name: get_device_status
tools.description: Get the live status of one of the user's devices (online, speed, battery, filter life).

tools.name: set_fan_speed
tools.description: Set the speed of a Hawa Aero fan. Speed must be an integer from 1 to 5.

tools.name: check_warranty
tools.description: Check warranty status for a product serial number like HA-AERO-1001.

tools.name: create_service_ticket
tools.description: Raise a service ticket for a technician visit. Needs the device, a short issue description and the user's 10-digit Indian mobile number.

response.text:
The Hawa Lock S1 runs on **8 x AA alkaline batteries (1.5 V)**. 

When purchasing replacements, make sure to get standard **1.5 V alkaline** batteries. **Do not use rechargeable 1.2 V batteries**, because their lower voltage will cause the lock to show a low battery warning much too early. 

Remember to replace all 8 batteries at the same time! Your users and settings will be saved and won't be lost when you change them.
